user_query: I'm planning a surprise birthday party for my best friend who is a music lover. Can you help me find the latest release of their favorite artist on Shazam? Additionally, fetch the track information from Soundcloud to create a personalized playlist for the party.

TaskList.description: Find the latest release from the favorite artist using Shazam.
Fetch track information from Soundcloud for the latest release found in Subtask 1.
Create a personalized playlist for the birthday party using the track information fetched from Soundcloud.
